publications.title: CrossQ: Batch Normalization in Deep Reinforcement Learning for Greater Sample Efficiency and Simplicity
publications.license: MIT author code; explicit Torch port
publications.native_core: SAC-style online continuous policy; joint current/next-state BatchRenorm critic forward; detached soft Bellman targets from same critic, no targetcritic; delayed actor/temperature.
publications.C3_fit: Continuous joint allocation and timing; stable/efficient bootstrapping supplies a conventional strong policy-learning control for terminal-feedback tasks.
publications.limitations: No explicit H-step sparse-credit reconstruction. Dense MuJoCo results do not establish sparse highD performance or finite-budget safety-component effects.
publications.task_adapter: Raw public SharedObjectMean replaces only actor mean; native state-dependent flat std/BRN/backbones remain. Short512warmup, reward×100 and alpha.01 are explicit; communication selectedR5 gamma.99/BRNwarmup1024, power selectedR3 retains its registeredgamma1/100kBRNwarmup. These are declared per-domain profiles, not uniform author defaults.
publications.status: Previously independently accepted task profiles; identity audit does not rerank

publications.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning with Gradient Eligibility Traces
publications.license: MIT author code; paper-equation correction declared
publications.native_core: PPO actor with live multistep lambda-return TDRC value correction and auxiliary h network: Delta_w=delta_lambda*gradV-h*grad(V+delta_lambda); Delta_theta=(delta_lambda-h)*gradh-beta*theta. Actor advantage is stale within rollout; critic/h live.
publications.C3_fit: Most direct multistep credit/value-learning comparator among these five; complete already-collected sequences contain delayed endpoint feedback without a decision-time oracle.
publications.limitations: Nonlinear deep/highD guarantees do not follow from linear GTD theory.6144steps only few rolloutcycles; h is not known true reward attribution.
publications.task_adapter: Paper Eq10/11 implemented with directly differentiable returns rather than author extra-grad multiplier. Corrected all32realtransitions plus storednext_obs avoids dropping radio terminalreward; original defectiveR1 retained. Shared public mean/native conststd and64x64V/h plus onlineRMS; radio rollout1024, power2048 declared. Both use native raw Gaussian likelihood and physical clip.
publications.status: Accepted feedback-complete versions; original31/32R1 is diagnostic only

publications.title: Reflective Policy Optimization
publications.license: No author license verified; independent paper-derived Torch implementation
publications.native_core: PPO L0 plus beta times chronological neighboring pair-ratio objective L1; BOTH adjacent density ratios differentiated, separately clipped, with same-episode masks.
publications.C3_fit: Temporal policy update uses adjacent already-observed state/action transitions and future-in-rollout advantages; this is not access to future disturbances during act.
publications.limitations: Two-step reflective objective is not an H-step reward redistribution mechanism. Its theoretical monotonic-improvement conditions are not automatic guarantees under finite minibatches/RMS/task architecture.
publications.task_adapter: Public shared mean/native conststd and64x64critic; shared Gym online population RMS explicitly differs from native batch/unbiased/±10/backwardRTG filter; no hidden2048calibration. Correct actual next-adv operand normalization/dynamicdone masks; radio lambda1 vs power.97 declared; raw Gaussian likelihood then physical clip.
publications.status: Previously accepted, matching-finalRMS weight attribution retained

publications.title: CCPO: Conservatively Constrained Policy Optimization Using State Augmentation
publications.publication: ECAI2023; Frontiers in AI and Applications372:2599–2606; DOI10.3233/FAIA230566
publications.license: No author-code license copied; independent paper-derived implementation
publications.native_core: Remaining safety-budget state, safety-promotion function SPF and adaptive weighted-cost reward penalty attached to PPO (paper framework can wrap other RL algorithms).
publications.C3_fit: Public remaining budget/history directly matches intertemporal shared-resource state; strong matched full-spend learning reference now independently confirmed in both domains.
publications.limitations: Common physical mapping already enforces total-budget feasibility. Good full-spend performance cannot separately establish necessity of SPF/penalty or transfer the paper almost-sure safety claim. Not inherently a terminal-credit solution.
publications.task_adapter: Public actualcost/history from balance, analytically feasible weighted-cost normalizer K_H=1.5-.5/H; shared_objects mean; gamma=costgamma=lambda1, nativefractionreward/noRMS, rollout256 and40value/atmost40actorKLlimitediterations. No hidden future/private geometry.
publications.status: Retained existing C3 control, not counted again as a newly discovered identity; matchedCUDA4 independently accepted

publications.title: No Representation, No Trust: Connecting Representation, Collapse, and Trust Issues in PPO
publications.license: MIT author core; retained notice licenses/PFO_MIT.txt; declared minimal Torch task port
publications.native_core: Clipped PPO plus detached actual behavior penultimate preactivation MSE; TanhNormal and state-dependent scale, independent actor/value Adam.
publications.task_adapter: Shared public object/total mean-and-scale heads, equal-head representation MSE, serial512 rollout/B64/10epochs; coefficient1, gamma.99/lambda1, no obs/reward RMS, no reward reshaping. SPO module is collector infrastructure only, not a sixth comparator and no SPO objective is used.
publications.selection_authority: Current explicit user decision; admission is not conditional on matching CrossQ scores or historical CrossQ-2 quality gates.
publications.limitations: User adoption does not convert historical frozen negative screening gates to PASS or establish that two training seeds are a completed five-seed formal comparison.
